title: Team member closeout: Thermal Circling Updraft (f42c24) — dedicated consolidation DELIVERED (all owner-gated decisions settled; three push-proven waves: dispositions, ADR-195/196/197 + skill + PDR-058/091, rule clauses + PDR-089 D8 + register drain); zero claims retained; Director final waypoint unblocked
body:
Team member closeout:
- Boundary owned: owner-named dedicated consolidation session (decision settlement + homing), under lane grant bc57343c (carve-out from Director claim 537f2f1c).
- Outcome: DELIVERED in two phases. Phase 1: every owner-gated promotion/decision in the estate walked and settled with the owner (Core stabilise-posture five all approved; fired-trigger routing ratified; graph/registry ADRs approved; EEF planning trio approved; Q-002 lane opened; backlog triage protocol agreed). Phase 2 (homing): three commits landed and push-proven — 7f655249c (dispositions recorded), 3a3784ef9 (ADR-195/196/197 + index, working-with-graphs skill + adapters + settings entry, PDR-058/091 amendments, ADR-167 note, four adversarially-verified withdrawals), 0a32ea36d (five watcher/liveness rule clauses, PDR-089 Decision 8, register drain of 11 graduated entries).
- Evidence: ls-remote-proven transfers for all three; the 25-agent adversarial refutation pass (14 of 18 proposed withdrawals refuted — the founding 15-of-18 class reproduced and caught pre-execution); the 4-agent drafting fan-out with first-hand critical review of every artefact.
- Claims / queue / git state: no claim ever opened (lane grant only); no queue entries; tree carries only live comms-stream churn; branch pushed at 0a32ea36d.
- Session complete announcement: this session's consolidation work is complete; remaining approved-unauthored amendments are register-recorded as owner-approved (PDR-064, PDR-011 two-clause, PDR-078 emit-side, PDR-085 + self-correcting-deliverables pair, continuity-disposition PDR, mechanical-firing-moments PDR, F1 PDR-051 one-liner, F2 commit-skill lock-wait alignment, F5 continuity-practice supersession clause, oak-plan amendment) — the next dedicated session authors without re-asking.
- Retained claims, if any, and handoff reason: none.
- Pickup notification required for follow-on agent: none required; the register statuses are the pickup surface.
- Heartbeat-end broadcast emitted: yes 450cb94a
- Surprise or changed understanding: the 15-of-18 withdrawal failure REPRODUCED at this seat (14/18) despite the agent having read the founding lesson that morning — adversarial-verify-before-withdrawal is now twice-proven mechanism; PDR-089 Decision 8 carries it.
- Blockers or risks: none live. Fitness at rest: register hard (designed drain pressure, drops as approved authoring lands), distilled hard (carries substance the mechanical-firing PDR will absorb), testing-strategy hard (pre-existing, untouched), repo-continuity hard (Director-owned).
- Handoff needed: Director lands the session's final waypoint (their stated plan); next dedicated session picks up the approved authoring queue from the register.
